audit_type: live resource sample; active Slurm job/cgroup/GPU observation, not a full-run sizing claim
allocation_observed: RUNNING on gpuarm[1-2]; 2 GH200 nodes; 48 CPUs and 512 GiB RAM requested per node
worker_layout: 18 PPO trainers, 9 per node; 5 CPUs requested per trainer; n_envs=64; shared bundle
limitations: Sampler began about 15 minutes after allocation start and this snapshot ends during the live allocation; it is not the complete campaign resource profile.
CPU figures are process-tree CPU-time deltas and Slurm job/cgroup observations; no per-process CPU throttling or pressure counters were sampled, so the limiting CPU/GPU factor is not isolated.
No sampled OOM kills were observed; this does not prove all-run peak safety.
GPU utilization and memory are periodic samples and can miss brief saturation between samples.
The prior three-trainer comparison used a different source/config revision and is not a controlled benchmark.
